# Aequitas Smart Insurance - Modern Insurance Operating System

> Aequitas is an AI-native property and casualty (P&C) insurance operating system designed to eliminate the 35% to 42% operational friction of traditional insurance carriers. It features 3-question enriched underwriting, live telematics risk deflation, instant agentic claims triage, parametric weather settlement, and sub-3-second commission settlement.

## Core Modules & Capabilities

### 1. 3-Question Enriched AI Underwriting
- Replaces 80-question legacy application forms with 3 inputs: Address, Vehicle, and Coverage Tier.
- Enriches risk models using Cape Analytics satellite computer vision (roof geometry, tree overhang, wildfire defensible space) and Smartcar OEM telematics.
- Powered by Google Gemini 2.5 / 3.x Flash server-side underwriting agent.

### 2. Live Telematics Risk Deflation
- Direct OEM integration with Tesla, Ford, Toyota, BMW, and GM connected vehicles via Smartcar API.
- Real-time IoT sensor ingestion for properties (Flo by Moen water shutoff, Ring security systems).
- Immediate, dynamic monthly premium reductions (up to 38% off baseline rates) for verified safe behaviors.

### 3. Sub-3-Second Agentic AI Claims Triage
- First Notice of Loss (FNOL) photo inspection using multimodal Gemini vision.
- Detects fraudulent image metadata, computes repair estimate distributions, and verifies policy limits.
- Claims under $1,500 with confidence scores > 90% are automatically approved and disbursed via instant push-to-card or RTP.

### 4. Parametric Weather & IoT Oracle Settlement
- Zero-paperwork, autonomous claim settlement.
- Binds to cryptographic weather oracles (NOAA hurricane wind speeds, USGS earthquake magnitude, National Weather Service flood gauges).
- Instant automatic payout triggered the instant verified thresholds are exceeded.

### 5. Multi-Carrier Comparative Rating
- Integrated with EZLynx, Boost Insurance MGA, and Sure Embedded APIs.
- Queries 40+ national carriers (Progressive, Travelers, Safeco, Nationwide) in under 800ms.
- Displays transparent cost-breakdown comparing pure loss cost vs. broker markups.

### 6. Sub-3-Second Real-Time Commission Payouts
- Solves the industry-wide 60-day broker commission delay.
- Employs an atomic 80/18/2 split: 80% to Carrier Risk Pool, 18% to Agency/Broker, 2% to Community Surplus Fund.
- Instant cash-outs via FedNow, RTP, and Stripe Connect Instant Payouts directly to business checking accounts in < 3 seconds.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints
- GET `/api/carriers/connectors`: Public directory of certified carrier APIs, supported insurance lines, and latency metrics.
- GET `/api/commissions/ledger`: Real-time ledger of earned commissions, atomic splits, and payout transaction hashes.
- POST `/api/commissions/instant-payout`: Executes instantaneous commission cash-out via FedNow or Stripe Connect.
- POST `/api/carriers/bind-external`: Programmatically binds an insurance policy with external MGA/carrier partners.
- POST `/api/carriers/webhook`: Secure inbound webhook receiver for carrier status events.
